title: 11 Best Herbal Teas For Body Odor
intro: Herbal teas for body odor are natural remedies made from plant extracts that help to reduce or eliminate body odor caused by excessive sweating. These teas are beneficial in treating body odor as they possess antimicrobial and antifungal properties that inhibit the growth of bacteria that cause body odor. Examples of herbal teas used to treat body odor include peppermint tea, which cools the skin and reduces sweat, lemongrass tea, which has antiseptic and antibacterial properties, and neem tea, which helps to control sweat and reduce body odor. Additionally, other herbal teas like ginger tea, chamomile tea, and tea tree oil tea can also be used to treat body odor, as they have anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that help to soothe and protect the skin from bacteria and other microorganisms.
